name: ai-os
description: Framework + Agent Skills for a headless AI assisting system over real folders: the knowledge layer (project-onboarding, wiki-onboarding, wiki-maintenance, user-onboarding), the job-archetype framework (file-ingest, user-synthesis, code), and file-preprocessing — staging-folder triage with a portable hash-keyed audit manifest any agent can produce or consume. Works in any Claude Code or Cowork session, and can be consumed by an automated pipeline from the same source.
